findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 8 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 56 questions numbered 1-56; by section: 8.1 9, 8.1.1 4, 8.1.2 3, 8.2 9, 8.2.1 4, 8.2.2 5, 8.3 5, 8.3.1 4, 8.4 4, 8.5 1, 8.5.1 5, 8.6 3.

Short questions over every section 8.1-8.6 in book order: definitions and statements, single induction steps, terms and coefficients, deductions, series for negative and fractional index, approximations, Pascal's triangle, remainders and digits, real-life uses. New numbers throughout; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed (odd-number sum, binomial proof (D), Example 31's formula). Every answer and step was checked by computation (sympy).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
